queryName: EKS Cluster Not Using Customer Managed KMS Key
descriptionText: EKS clusters running Kubernetes 1.28 or later envelope encrypt all Kubernetes API data by default with an AWS owned KMS key. EKS clusters should be associated with a customer managed KMS key to meet stricter security and compliance requirements (e.g. CIS Amazon EKS Benchmark 5.3.1) on key ownership, rotation, key policy and audit visibility
